Perks › Uncommon

Bone Trader

Uncommon perk · Active ability

Once per round, choose one of your bones and one face-down boneyard bone to swap.

In-game card text

How it works

On your turn, choose one of your bones and one face-down boneyard bone, and they trade places. You don't see the new bone until it lands in your hand.

  • Each copy gives one swap per hand.
  • Using it does not end your turn: you can still play or draw afterwards.
  • The bone you give away goes back into the boneyard face-down.
  • It needs at least one bone in the boneyard.

At a glance

RarityUncommon
TypeActive ability
UsesOne use per hand for each copy you hold. Uses refill at the start of every hand.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 300 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Common perks.
